name: Ham Bands
author: Robert (leafbox)
description: Amateur radio frequency allocations by country and license class in the Omarchy bar: pick your country and license, see exactly where you may transmit.

barWidget.description: Band allocations by country and license class.

schema.label: Country
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the allocation table to show, e.g. US, GB, DE, AU

schema.label: Your license class
schema.description: Class id from the country's table, e.g. technician, foundation, ein. Blank shows every class

schema.label: Bar pill shows
schema.description: band shows the allocation around the current frequency highlight; class shows your license class name
